vetSays.line: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +2 clean.
🍲 A man, maybe 60s eats with A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm — bowls side by side, talk low.
📓 Journal: the woman in her 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm taught the woman in her 60s, with a long braid Wound Care.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)
👂 Overheard — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "Okay — what's the first step?"
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)
You give A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm 3 portions of Dried beans, with the village watching. They look at you differently now.
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm telling A person, maybe 50s about you. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
🍲 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm is eating by the fire — not talking, just eating.
"Can we talk? Have you seen anyone on the roads? Anyone at all? I'm asking everyone." (Talk to A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm.)
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm telling A person, maybe 50s about Ananya. The story's getting bigger than what happened.

You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 60s telling A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm about A woman, maybe 60s, with a long braid. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.

A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm spends the afternoon with the tree with lobed leaves and oval nuts in scaly caps — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. Raw, it knots the stomach. Cooked... fine. The fire learns the rule before the name: cook it, or else.
💡 The tree with lobed leaves and oval nuts in scaly caps — THAT's what A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm was describing. White Oak Acorns. It clicks like a key turning.
The Journal notes it: White Oak Acorns — cook it, or else. (A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm tested it.)
📓 Journal: Benoit taught the woman in her 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm Camp Cooking.
📋 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
🍂 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm gathers deadfall — 1 stick + 1 fiber. The pile grows. (5 sticks now.)
👂 Overheard — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "We need more firewood before dark. Who's with me?"

You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm telling Benoit about A woman, maybe 60s, with a long braid. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
📋 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
🍂 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm gathers deadfall — 2 sticks + 1 fiber. The pile grows. (7 sticks now.)

Ananya has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm is showing everyone White Oak Acorns by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The journal grows — the human way.
📓 Journal: the woman in her 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm taught the man in his 30s Camp Cooking.
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm telling Ananya about Bill. The retelling is already better than the event.
📋 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.

A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about moth the size of a dinner plate. Hit it while it folds. The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it."
🍂 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm gathers deadfall — 1 stick. The pile grows. (5 sticks now.)
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 60s telling A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm about you. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm is humming something. It stops when they notice you listening.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm drew a clustering spiny palm hung with bunches of orange-red plum-sized fruit in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.

A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm spends the afternoon with the giant rhubarb-like leaves, round burrs, first-year = leaf rosette with no stalk — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. An hour passes. Then another. Nothing. The fire nods. That's dinner, maybe.

💡 The giant rhubarb-like leaves, round burrs, first-year = leaf rosette with no stalk — THAT's what A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm was describing. Burdock. It clicks like a key turning.
📓 Journal: the woman in her 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm taught the woman in her 60s, with a long braid Herbal Medicine.
You catch fragments by the fire — Tashi telling A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm about Ursula. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm telling Benoit about you. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.

A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm spends the afternoon with the tree with compound leaves and hard nuts — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. An hour passes. Then another. Nothing. The fire nods. That's dinner, maybe.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm showed Ursula the Blackberry — "remember it." Word gets around.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm is over the cookpot, blowing on a spoonful before it goes back in. The pantry won't fill itself.
📋 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm — 🍲 Cook. They'll report back by next part.
🍲 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm cooked for the haven — meals stretched.
🛡️ Ananya, Nicole, Chantelle and Fatima met them at the door — 4 put down. Ananya, Nicole, Chantelle, Fatima are hurt.
🛡️ Ananya, Nicole, Chantelle and Fatima met them at the door — 4 put down. Ananya, Nicole, Chantelle, Fatima are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred The Ugly Beast falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred The Ugly Beast!
🛡️ Ananya, Charlotte, Nicole, Chantelle and Olivia met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Ananya, Charlotte, Nicole, Chantelle, Olivia are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
(Elder Performance Review's hide absorbs 6.)
You STRIKE the Elder Performance Review for 69 (Shard spear).
(Elder Performance Review's hide absorbs 6.)
You STRIKE the Elder Performance Review for 73 (Shard spear).
The Elder Performance Review falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder Performance Review!

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tashi just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ananya, Nicole, Chantelle, Naran and Tashi met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 driven off. Ananya, Nicole, Naran, Tashi are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Naran just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
